### Root Cause & Why CI Differed Narrative

1. **Finding 1 (Rollover test `repo_root` parameter & doubled `.venv`)**:
   - **Root Cause**: In [test_claudex_supervisor.py](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/claudex-7210-delta3/tests/orchestration/test_claudex_supervisor.py#L446-L455), the delta-1 commit passed `repo_root=_repo_python().parent.parent` to [`th.request_claudex_rollover`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/claudex-7210-delta3/scripts/orchestration/thread_handoff.py#L1849). Because `_repo_python()` returns the path `<repo_root>/.venv/bin/python`, `.parent.parent` evaluates to `<repo_root>/.venv` (the `.venv` virtual environment directory, rather than the repository root).
   - Inside [`th.request_claudex_rollover`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/claudex-7210-delta3/scripts/orchestration/thread_handoff.py#L1896), the interpreter path is constructed as `repo_root / ".venv/bin/python"`, which evaluated to `<repo_root>/.venv/.venv/bin/python`.
   - **Why it differed from local**: On the local development environment, the directory `.venv/` contained a stray internal symlink `.venv -> .../.venv`, allowing `.venv/.venv/bin/python` to resolve and execute. In CI (`/home/runner/work/...`), `.venv/.venv` did not exist, immediately failing with `[Errno 2] No such file or directory: '/home/runner/work/.../.venv/.venv/bin/python'`.
   - **Fix**: Defined `_CANONICAL_REPO_ROOT = th.canonical_state_root(_REPO_ROOT)` in [test_claudex_supervisor.py](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/claudex-7210-delta3/tests/orchestration/test_claudex_supervisor.py#L31) and passed `repo_root=_CANONICAL_REPO_ROOT` to [`th.request_claudex_rollover`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/claudex-7210-delta3/scripts/orchestration/thread_handoff.py#L1849).

2. **Finding 2 (Timeout-less `subprocess.run` calls under `tests/`)**:
   - **Root Cause**: The subprocess invocations in [`test_resolve_relaunch_python_priorities`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/claudex-7210-delta3/tests/orchestration/test_claudex_supervisor.py#L536) and [`test_supervisor_launches_in_venv_less_worktree`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/claudex-7210-delta3/tests/orchestration/test_claudex_supervisor.py#L574) lacked explicit timeout arguments, violating the guard in [test_subprocess_timeout_guard.py](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/claudex-7210-delta3/tests/test_subprocess_timeout_guard.py).
   - **Fix**: Added explicit `timeout=30` to all git fixture calls (`git worktree add`, `git worktree remove`) and `timeout=60` to the supervisor E2E run in [test_claudex_supervisor.py](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/claudex-7210-delta3/tests/orchestration/test_claudex_supervisor.py#L550-L625).
